company.name: Datacultr
company.shortDescription: Datacultr is the Global OS for Risk Management & Debt Collections for High Risk Lending, reduces defaults & NPAs
company.description: Datacultr is a PaaS that allows consumer lending companies to significantly reduce their risk on 'New to Credit' customers. Datacultr allows the lender to give out unsecured loans, at a lower risk, by allowing borrowers to present their newly purchased or existing smartphone as collateral.

productsAndServices.description: A digital platform that automates and enhances debt collection processes by engaging borrowers directly through their devices to improve collection efficiency and reduce non-performing loans.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Debt Collection Platform

productsAndServices.description: Technology that remotely locks financed devices like smartphones, tablets, and smart TVs to enforce payment compliance and reduce defaults in device financing.
productsAndServices.name: Device Lock Solutions

productsAndServices.description: A digital workflow tool that enables lenders to engage defaulters directly on their devices to create actionable repayment plans without relying on call agents.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Promise To Pay

productsAndServices.description: A platform to send authenticated legal notices digitally to borrowers’ devices with guaranteed delivery and instant acknowledgment, reducing costs and improving response rates.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Legal Notice

productsAndServices.description: A device locking and financing platform integrated at the OS level to support smartphone OEMs in expanding financing schemes and partnerships with financiers and telecom operators.
productsAndServices.name: OEM Partnership Device Affordability Programs

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $20,000, representing 1.75% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $14,749,561 to $13,777,766, a 0.93x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 35 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 44 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Credgenics, SPOCTO, Paytm.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
